instruction: Please help me install the extension Markdown All in One in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing Markdown All in One extension in VS Code. The evaluator checks if the extension ID 'yzhang.markdown-all-in-one' is present in the output of 'code --list-extensions'. The existing metric 'is_extension_installed' is used with type='contain' to verify the extension is installed.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Command will fail at runtime - shell piping syntax used without shell=true parameter
The command array ['code', '--list-extensions', '|', 'grep', 'yzhang.markdown-all-in-one'] treats '|' and 'grep' as literal arguments instead of shell operators
get_vm_command_line uses shell=false by default (general.py:12), which means pipes and shell operators are not interpreted
This will cause the command to fail or produce incorrect output, preventing proper verification
Logic flow is otherwise correct: code --list-extensions | grep extension-id would verify installation if shell syntax worked
Expected value 'yzhang.markdown-all-in-one' is the correct official extension ID
Coverage is complete - checking if extension is installed satisfies the instruction requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add 'shell': true to the result config: {"type": "vm_command_line", "command": [...], "shell": true}
Alternative fix: Use string command instead of array when shell=true is set: {"command": "code --list-extensions | grep yzhang.markdown-all-in-one", "shell": true}
Alternative approach: Remove grep and use command=['code', '--list-extensions'] only, then rely on is_extension_installed's 'contain' check to find the extension in the full list
